rules.rule_summary: Instrument is NQ (CME), sized via MNQ where risk requires
rules.notes: instrument.symbol / point_value_nq / point_value_mnq. Hephaestus's size proposal (§9) chooses NQ vs MNQ units symbolically; the Vault risk ceiling (§9.2) is what forces the MNQ downshift.

rules.rule_summary: Active entry window W1 (08:00-11:00 ET) gates trigger emission
rules.notes: session.entry_window + session.entry_windows.W1. Desk re-check: Helios verifies Snapshot.ts falls inside the active window (outside = FAIL). Window variant is config-selected, never agent-selected.

rules.rule_summary: W1 vs W2 entry-window tournament; backtest declares the winner
rules.notes: TOURNAMENT. W2 runs with Vault risk parameters unchanged. Adoption of a non-W1 winner requires Angus sign-off + doc version bump (§10.5).

rules.rule_summary: W3 other sessions (London etc.) - hypothesis H3
rules.notes: Parked until v1 validates; intentionally not configured in strategy.yaml.

rules.rule_summary: EOD flatten of any open position before CME close (default 15:55 ET)
rules.notes: session.eod_flatten. Explicitly a VAULT RULE, not strategy. Desk cannot own: agents never see open positions.

rules.rule_summary: Entry TFs are exactly 1m/2m/3m/5m
rules.notes: timeframes.entry; resampled from the 1m base. Desk re-check: Apollo verifies Trigger.tf is in the allowlist and Trigger.ts sits on that TF's bar-close grid.

rules.rule_summary: MTF arbitration: simultaneous valid triggers on multiple TFs -> take the highest TF
rules.notes: CONFIRMED-Angus; triggers._mtf_arbitrate. NOT re-derivable by the Desk - losing-TF triggers are not in the contract, so this is an engine-trust point. Hermes must only ever be handed the arbitrated winner; Apollo can only sanity-check the tf field.

rules.rule_summary: 15m context TF produces the HTF trend/range regime
rules.notes: snapshot._htf_regime (fractal swings, k=2). Raw 15m bars are not in the Snapshot, so the Desk consumes Snapshot.htf_regime as ground truth; the derived-flag consistency check is Atlas's (§4 row).

rules.rule_summary: 1h/4h context TFs provide HTF range extremes
rules.notes: timeframes.range_extreme_tfs. ENGINE GAP: session-anchored 4h resampler deferred (flagged in strategy.yaml); these levels are absent from Snapshot. Needed by Atlas for the §7.2 location veto - until present Atlas must proxy with prior_day/week H/L and session extremes. Flag as a Snapshot-contract gap for Phase 3.

rules.rule_summary: Bollinger Bands 20/SMA/close/2-sigma; basis (BB MA) is a core cluster level
rules.notes: indicators.bollinger.*. Agents cannot recompute BB (no raw bars in Snapshot). Apollo runs a corruption tripwire instead: tfs[tf].bb_lower <= bb_basis <= bb_upper for every entry TF.

rules.rule_summary: NY session VWAP anchored 09:30 ET cash open; does NOT exist pre-market; bands 1/2/3-sigma
rules.notes: indicators.ny_vwap.anchor; architecture invariant 1. Desk re-check: Helios - if Snapshot.ts < 09:30 ET then indicators.ny_vwap.mid must be null; a non-null pre-market NY VWAP is an engine bug = FAIL (fail-closed cross-check is exactly the Desk's value).

rules.rule_summary: Daily VWAP: CORE component, CME 18:00 ET anchor, full 1/2/3-sigma band set, the only VWAP pre-9:30
rules.notes: indicators.daily_vwap.* (anchor CONFIRMED). Helios re-checks daily_vwap.mid is present at all times; missing/null = FAIL (fail-closed on stale indicators).

rules.rule_summary: Volume profile (session + daily): POC, VAH/VAL, HVN/LVN; POC is a core cluster level
rules.notes: indicators.volume_profile.*; value_area_pct=70 is a PLACEHOLDER pending Angus. Atlas consumes daily_profile.poc/vah/val in cluster and target re-derivation.

rules.rule_summary: Weekly profile anchor as a tested variant
rules.notes: volume_profile.weekly_enabled=false (TOURNAMENT flag). If adopted post-tournament it becomes an engine computation feeding the same lanes.

rules.rule_summary: Session boxes Asia/London/NY provide session extremes for targets/liquidity
rules.notes: session.boxes.* (PLACEHOLDER clock times pending Angus). Feeds Snapshot.target_menu *_session_high/low. Helios re-checks Snapshot.session label is consistent with ts.

rules.rule_summary: Data levels: extremes printed within N min of scheduled releases; role = bias + targets
rules.notes: indicators.data_levels.window_min (CALIBRATE, start 15). Helios re-checks each Snapshot.data_levels entry's event_time is a real calendar release within the window. Feeds §6.3 override and §7.5 news handling.

rules.rule_summary: MIG LiquidityEdge is EXCLUDED; journal MIG targets re-map to nearest computable level
rules.notes: Angus scope decision, enforced structurally (engine computes no MIG inputs, so no agent can reference one). Re-mapping is Phase-2 calibration work (§12.2); a native absorption detector is a future module requiring separate validation + sign-off.

rules.rule_summary: Confluence cluster: >=2 distinct level types within proximity tolerance
rules.notes: cluster.min_level_types + cluster.tolerance_points/tolerance_pct (CALIBRATE, start ~10 pts / 0.04%). PRIMARY Atlas re-check: re-derive the cluster from raw prices in Snapshot.indicators (tfs.*.bb_basis, daily_vwap/ny_vwap mid+bands, daily_profile.poc) and confirm Trigger.cluster_center and composition match; mismatch = FAIL.

rules.rule_summary: Pre-9:30 the VWAP family = daily VWAP only
rules.notes: Automatic in engine (NY VWAP null upstream, snapshot._gather_levels skips). Desk re-check assigned to Helios (time-gated): ts < 09:30 => no nyvwap_* member names in any Cluster.members.

rules.rule_summary: Confluence count = distinct level TYPES touched (VWAP x1, BB x1, POC x1, structural x1)
rules.notes: Cluster.confluence_count/types. Atlas re-derives the type count and fails if Trigger.confluence_count differs. Note: engine's displacement path hard-codes count=2 (triggers.py _test_candle) - flag for verification that displacement confluence is counted per §3.2, not floored.

rules.rule_summary: Rejection block: trades into cluster, CLOSES back on trade side of all cluster levels, leaves wick through; tradeable zone = body edge to wick extreme
rules.notes: CONFIRMED-Angus; triggers._test_candle. Apollo re-check is currently PARTIAL: Trigger carries wick_low/wick_high/close but not the candle's full OHLC. CONTRACT GAP: add trigger-candle open/high/low so Apollo can fully re-derive (a)-(c). Zone bounds re-checkable now via wick_low/wick_high.

rules.rule_summary: Displacement: body closes through >=2 cluster levels, body/range >= B_min, close in extreme quartile (top 25% long / bottom 25% short)
rules.notes: triggers.displacement.min_levels_through / body_range_min (CALIBRATE 0.6) / close_extreme_quartile; optional ATR floor atr_floor_k (CALIBRATE 1.0, disabled). Apollo re-check PARTIAL for the same OHLC-gap reason (range/high not derivable for longs); levels-through count re-checkable from indicators + close.

rules.rule_summary: Over-extension = touch of NY VWAP +/-2-sigma (extreme = +/-3-sigma)
rules.notes: triggers.over_extension_sigma / over_extension_extreme_sigma. Feeds pattern-A classification (§4) and 'A-at-extension' in §9. Apollo re-checks candle extreme vs indicators.ny_vwap.upper_2/lower_2 (full re-derivation needs the OHLC contract fix).

rules.rule_summary: Pattern A (reversal): a close-through that reverses a ±2 daily-VWAP over-extension -> retest of the closest structural level
rules.notes: Apollo re-check (binary): pattern==A => kind==displacement AND a ±2 daily-VWAP touch within the prior _EXT_LOOKBACK entry-TF bars. Any inconsistency = FAIL. Taxonomy per ANGUS 22-Jul-2026, docs/STRATEGY-SETUP-TAXONOMY.md (authoritative).

rules.rule_summary: Pattern B (continuation): a close-through with no qualifying prior ±2 extension, off a stacked confluence -> retest, with-trend
rules.notes: Apollo re-check (binary): pattern==B => kind==displacement AND NOT the A extension condition. NB kind==displacement implies A OR B, not B alone. Taxonomy per ANGUS 22-Jul-2026, docs/STRATEGY-SETUP-TAXONOMY.md (authoritative).

rules.rule_summary: Pattern B2 (rejection/fade): price wicks into a level and closes back -> fade off the level at the retest
rules.notes: Apollo re-check (binary): pattern==B2 <=> kind==rejection. No htf_flag constraint - B2 works with- or counter-HTF. Taxonomy per ANGUS 22-Jul-2026, docs/STRATEGY-SETUP-TAXONOMY.md (authoritative).

rules.rule_summary: HTF flag with_trend / counter_trend / range tagged per trade
rules.notes: triggers._htf_flag. Atlas re-check: Trigger.htf_flag must equal the deterministic map of Snapshot.htf_regime + Trigger.direction (range->range; uptrend+long->with_trend; etc.). The counter-trend confluence escalation it drives is enforced at §7.1.

rules.rule_summary: Detect the confluence cluster on each entry TF
rules.notes: detect_triggers evaluates all four TFs per close. Not desk-verifiable across TFs (Desk sees only the arbitrated winner); Atlas verifies the winning TF's cluster (§3.1 row).

rules.rule_summary: Trigger must be a rejection block (A, B2) or displacement (B); the candle must CLOSE to confirm
rules.notes: Architecture invariant 3 (closed candles only; no-lookahead test). Apollo re-checks: kind is in {rejection_block, displacement}, Trigger.ts == Snapshot.ts, and ts is a completed-bar boundary for Trigger.tf.

rules.rule_summary: Active entry limit rule E1: limit at the BB MA
rules.notes: entry.variant=E1; engine emits Trigger.entry_ref. Hephaestus re-check: Verdict.entry == Snapshot.indicators.tfs[Trigger.tf].bb_basis, tick-rounded (instrument.tick_size). Under E2/E3 the symbolic formula swaps (50% of wick span; nearest penetrated cluster level) - agent file references entry.variant, never a hard-coded rule.

rules.rule_summary: E1/E2/E3 limit-price tournament (replaces 'what makes the most sense')
rules.notes: TOURNAMENT, one axis at a time per §12.3. Winner adoption = Angus sign-off + doc bump.

rules.rule_summary: Stop goes beyond the wick extreme of the trigger candle / displacement origin; structural
rules.notes: Trigger.stop_ref. Hephaestus re-check (binary): long => Verdict.stop < Trigger.wick_low (strictly beyond, tick-rounded); short => Verdict.stop > Trigger.wick_high.

rules.rule_summary: Stop is never widened
rules.notes: Vault-enforced order management post-verdict. Desk cannot own: agents never see open positions or working orders.

rules.rule_summary: No fill -> no chase; order cancels if price runs T_cancel points beyond entry unfilled
rules.notes: entry.cancel_if_runs_points (CALIBRATE; PLACEHOLDER value flagged for Angus - doc gives no start number). Live order-lifecycle rule, deterministic; the backtest fill model mirrors it.

rules.rule_summary: One position at a time; no overlapping trades ever
rules.notes: CONFIRMED-Angus; architecture invariant 4; entry.one_position_at_a_time. Desk is stateless per candidate and cannot own position-state rules.

rules.rule_summary: Target menu: VWAP mid/+/-1/+/-2-sigma, POC, session extremes, data extremes, prior-day H/L, weekly H/L, pullback origin (B2), HTF range extremes
rules.notes: Snapshot.target_menu (Level list with signed distances). Hephaestus re-check: Verdict.target corresponds to a menu Level (∓ front-run F). ENGINE GAP: HTF 1h/4h extremes and B2 pullback-origin are not yet in the menu (deferred/trade-specific) - close before Phase 3.

rules.rule_summary: Selection step 1: list opposing structural levels beyond entry, ordered by distance
rules.notes: target_menu.distance is signed (+ above price). Hephaestus filters the menu to the trade side (long: distance>0 beyond entry) when re-deriving the default target.

rules.rule_summary: Default targets by pattern: A -> VWAP middle; B2 -> next structural level in move direction; B -> opposing liquidity preferring +/-2-sigma alignment
rules.notes: Deterministic selection tree (Spec-1 Step 7 territory). Hephaestus re-derives the default from Trigger.pattern + target_menu and FAILS if the proposed target deviates without a valid §6.3 override.

rules.rule_summary: News-day override: untaken data extreme beyond the default target becomes the target
rules.notes: CONFIRMED-Angus; targets.news_day_override=true. Deterministic given news_calendar + Snapshot.data_levels. Desk re-check split across lanes without sharing verdicts: Helios independently gates 'high-impact day + data extreme untaken' from data_levels; Hephaestus independently gates 'target == that data extreme when it lies beyond the default'. Both conditions are binary from Snapshot fields.

rules.rule_summary: Fallback variant: VWAP -1/+1 as simpler news-override proxy
rules.notes: targets.news_override_vwap_proxy=false; tournament variant to test.

rules.rule_summary: Fill front-run: working target = level ∓ F points
rules.notes: CONFIRMED-Angus; targets.front_run_points (CALIBRATE, start 2-3, mid 2.5). Hephaestus re-check: Verdict.target == menu level ∓ F (long: level − F). Backtest mirror (target touched-minus-F counts as filled) lives in the backtest fill model.

rules.rule_summary: RR floor: nearest valid target < 1.5R -> skip the trade
rules.notes: targets.rr_floor (CALIBRATE). Hephaestus re-derives R = (target−entry)/(entry−stop) from the Verdict's own numbers and FAILS below floor. Also feeds §9 full-unit condition (target >= 2R).

rules.rule_summary: Alignment bonus: prefer targets where >=2 menu levels stack within tolerance
rules.notes: targets.alignment_min_stack; a preference/tie-break inside the deterministic tree, NOT a binary gate. Hephaestus notes stack alignment in the thesis; it must not veto on its absence.

rules.rule_summary: Confluence minimum: 3 counter-trend; 2 with-trend (with-trend at reduced risk)
rules.notes: filters.min_confluence_counter_trend/with_trend. ENGINE GAP FLAG: detect_triggers currently emits any count>=2 with no htf-conditional filter - the filter must be applied engine-side pre-Desk (verify in Step 7/8), else Atlas's gate is the only stop. Atlas re-check (binary): confluence_count >= threshold(htf_flag), counter_trend threshold also applied when htf_flag==range unless Angus rules otherwise (ambiguity - escalate). The 'reduced risk' half is §9/Hephaestus.

rules.rule_summary: Location veto: no longs at HTF range top / no shorts at range bottom
rules.notes: filters.location_veto. Judgment-shaped gate the Desk owns (engine 1h/4h extremes deferred). Binary pass: trade direction is not INTO the nearest opposing HTF extreme within cluster.tolerance_points, using prior_day/week H/L, session_high/low, and (once in contract) 1h/4h range extremes. Fail-closed if required fields missing.

rules.rule_summary: Invalidation-at-entry: trigger candle simultaneously touching opposing +/-1-sigma -> stand down
rules.notes: Hypothesis to test; filters.invalidation_at_entry=false. If promoted: engine mechanical check + Apollo re-check (needs trigger-candle OHLC in contract).

rules.rule_summary: Volatility stand-down (opening range vs ATR)
rules.notes: [OPEN] - no computable definition yet; intentionally unconfigured. Natural future home is Helios (session/volatility lane) once Angus signs off a definition; must arrive as engine computation + Helios binary gate, not agent vibes.

rules.rule_summary: News is a bias/target input, NOT a blackout
rules.notes: Helios must NOT veto solely for proximity to a release while H4 is disabled - its news gate verifies news context is correctly represented (data_levels present on release days, §6.3 conditions evaluated) and otherwise passes. Guards against the LLM inventing an unwritten blackout rule; keeps §7.5 semantics.

rules.rule_summary: Slippage modeled punitively near releases
rules.notes: fills.slippage_ticks_news + news_slippage_window_min (spec-1 fill realism). Backtest-only mechanics; no live-behavior owner.

rules.rule_summary: H4: no entry within N min of release
rules.notes: Test hypothesis; filters.news_entry_buffer_enabled=false (buffer_min PLACEHOLDER). If promoted: engine time filter + Helios re-check.

rules.rule_summary: Active trade management = V0 set-and-forget (baseline)
rules.notes: management.variant=V0. In-trade management is executed by the Vault (only layer that sees the open position); the Desk proposes nothing about management. Config selects the variant.

rules.rule_summary: V1: break-even on TOUCH of +1R (any TF tick), stop moved to entry exact
rules.notes: Definition CONFIRMED-Angus; management.v1_be_at_r=1.0. Tournament variant, off by default; if it wins the head-to-head it becomes a Vault management rule.

rules.rule_summary: V2 BE at first VWAP-band milestone; V3 BE at 09:30 open if entered pre-open; V4 50% partial at first structural level with runner
rules.notes: Tournament variants (management.v4_partial_pct=50 for V4). Any winner becomes a deterministic Vault rule; never a Desk judgment.

rules.rule_summary: Tournament protocol: variants over identical data, Monte Carlo distribution comparison, winner-or-V0 goes live; priority head-to-head V1 vs V0 over Jan-Jul first
rules.notes: Adoption gate = Angus sign-off + doc version bump (§10.5 governance). One axis at a time per §12.3.

rules.rule_summary: Full vs half unit: full requires 3+ confluences AND (with_trend OR A-at-extension) AND target >= 2R; any of {2 confluences, oversized stop, late-window entry, thin target} -> half
rules.notes: Hephaestus proposes Verdict.size from Snapshot/Trigger only: confluence_count, htf_flag, pattern + §3.5 extension state, re-derived RR, Snapshot.ts vs window end (late-window derivable without Helios's verdict), stop distance. All inputs binary/mechanical - Vault should deterministically recompute as backstop. CONFIG GAP: 'oversized stop' and 'late-window' thresholds are undefined - flag for Angus before Phase 3.

rules.rule_summary: Absolute per-trade risk ceiling from Monte Carlo vs eval rules (well below sample's $400)
rules.notes: Value pending Spec-4 MC; intentionally absent from strategy.yaml. Vault clamps Hephaestus's proposed size; the Desk never knows the ceiling (account-state adjacent).

rules.rule_summary: Max trades/day: 3 (config range 2-3)
rules.notes: vault.max_trades_per_day. Desk structurally cannot own: agents never see today's trade count.

rules.rule_summary: Daily halt after 2 losses or −2R on the day, whichever first
rules.notes: vault.daily_halt_losses / daily_halt_r (placeholder; MC calibrates). Desk never sees P&L/outcomes - Vault-only by construction.

rules.rule_summary: Drawdown kill-switch vs trailing drawdown buffer
rules.notes: Parameters from Spec-4 MC + firm rules. Live-account state; no LLM access (architecture invariant 6).

rules.rule_summary: Every verdict (taken/skipped/vetoed) logged to strict-schema append-only journal with reason
rules.notes: Hermes's Verdict JSON is the logged artifact; a schema-invalid or missing Verdict is itself logged as a veto (fail-closed). Log feeds §10.5 stats and §12.5 diagnostics.

rules.rule_summary: Nightly stats refresh; weekly Edge-Lab-style review generated as PROPOSALS ONLY
rules.notes: Offline deterministic analytics over the Vault journal; produces written hypotheses only; no write path to rules, config, or agent files.

rules.rule_summary: Rule changes require out-of-sample evidence + Angus sign-off + strategy-doc version bump; the system never edits its own rules
rules.notes: CONFIRMED-Angus. Extends to agent prompts: per ai-workflow-rules, an agent-file edit IS a strategy change (versioned, logged in progress-tracker).

rules.rule_summary: Agents grade against this doc and propose; Python owns sizing, stops, limits, kill-switch, execution
rules.notes: Enforced structurally: Vault has no import path from any LLM-calling module (architecture invariant 6); no Desk agent has an outbound channel. Hermes emits a Verdict proposal only - the pinned schema {trade, pattern, direction, entry, stop, target, size, grade, thesis, gates}.

rules.rule_summary: Hermes orchestration: poll the four specialists, require UNANIMITY, fail-closed on invalid/missing/late specialist output, assemble Verdict + auditable thesis
rules.notes: One specialist fail = veto. Hermes never overrides a FAIL, adds no market judgment of its own, and never shows one specialist another's verdict (independence rule). Any non-schema JSON from a specialist = FAIL = veto; Verdict.gates records each named gate pass/fail for the journal.

rules.rule_summary: Telegram alerts fire from the Vault only, post-risk-check
rules.notes: Phase 4; bot token lives Vault-side only. Reinforces the no-agent-outbound-channel constraint.

rules.rule_summary: Inbound /status /pause /flatten commands locked to Angus's chat ID
rules.notes: Later phase; deterministic identity check in the Vault. Human-facing control surface, never routed through the Desk.

rules.rule_summary: Data: 1-minute NQ Jan 2026 -> present via Databento; in-repo volume-based continuous front-month
rules.notes: data.primary_start; src/engine/data.py derives the unspliced front-month (auditable roll). Foundation for both backtest and live snapshots.

rules.rule_summary: 2025 data is a regime-robustness check ONLY, not pass/fail
rules.notes: Evaluation-governance rule (the honesty guard); data.robustness_2025 flag. Interpreting robustness results is an Angus/analysis decision, not a mechanical gate.

rules.rule_summary: February re-run must approximately reproduce the 28 hand trades; divergences audited one-by-one; skipped days traded only on valid triggers with gap analysis
rules.notes: Angus-led Phase-2 gate over backtest output (data/reference/feb2026_hand_log.csv). Anti-tuning guardrail: divergences are reproduced + documented, never threshold-fitted away.

rules.rule_summary: Tournaments W x E x V run as separate axes, one fixed at a time - no combinatorial grid search
rules.notes: Overfitting guard; methodology enforced in the backtest harness and Angus review.

rules.rule_summary: Mar-Jul 2026 out-of-sample untouched until rules lock
rules.notes: Governance rule; worth a hard date-range guard in backtest config so a pre-lock run cannot silently read the OOS window.

rules.rule_summary: Per-slice expectancy diagnostics: pattern x TF x confluence count x HTF flag x time bucket x news flag
rules.notes: Leak-location tooling. Slice keys deliberately align with Trigger/Snapshot fields (pattern, tf, confluence_count, htf_flag, ts, data_levels) so the live Vault journal supports identical cuts.

rules.rule_summary: Monte Carlo: winning config vs 50K eval (3K target / 2K trailing DD) -> pass probability, attempts/cost, blowup risk -> sizing config -> firm selection
rules.notes: Spec 4. Output feeds the Vault size ceiling (§9.2) and daily-halt calibration (§10.2); firm selection is a human decision on MC output.

rules.rule_summary: Live paper: TradingView charts, agents grade real-time, human executes
rules.notes: Phase-5 operating mode. Desk still grades every candidate and the Vault still gates/logs verdicts before any alert reaches Angus; the human is the executor of last resort.
